description: This file defines the interface for the RBUS-based telemetry module, including type definitions, function declarations for parameter retrieval, event listener registration/unregistration, method calling, and method existence checks within the rbus telemetry system.

methods.name: getRbusParameterVal
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified RBus parameter.

methods.name: getRbusProfileParamValues
methods.description: Gets profile parameter values for a list of parameters.

methods.name: registerRbusT2EventListener
methods.description: Registers an event listener for RBus telemetry events.

methods.name: unregisterRbusT2EventListener
methods.description: Unregisters the previously registered RBus telemetry event listener.

methods.name: rbusT2ConsumerReg
methods.description: Registers an RBus T2 consumer with specific trigger conditions.

methods.name: rbusMethodCaller
methods.description: Calls a specified RBus method with input parameters and a callback.

methods.name: rbusCheckMethodExists
methods.description: Checks if a particular RBus method exists.

methods.name: T2RbusReportEventConsumer
methods.description: Reports an event consumer subscription or notification.

ctags.name: rbusMethodCallBackPtr
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*rbusMethodCallBackPtr) (rbusHandle_t handle, char const* methodName, rbusError_t /
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * methodName,rbusError_t retStatus,rbusObject_t params)
